name: Loupe & Lettres — Compare two CSV exports

parameters.content:
## Loupe & Lettres — créé avec l'aide de l'IA

### How it works
This manual workflow compares two CSV exports on one exact key column (for example an order ID). It reports rows missing on either side, changed fields, repeated keys and invalid numeric values. The workflow adds no node that sends or stores data and needs no account, API, credential or AI model. Your n8n instance may keep the inputs and outputs in its execution history, depending on its configuration.

### Setup
Import this JSON into a fresh workflow and run it once with the synthetic orders in “Example inputs”. Then replace key (the key column name), csvA and csvB (the complete CSV texts), and optionally delimiter (one character, default comma) and numericFields (columns to compare as plain decimals such as 10.5 or 10.50). Keep the JavaScript string escaping; JSON.stringify in your editor helps.

### Reading the result
missingInB / missingInA: keys present in one file only. changed: matched keys whose other columns differ (trimmed text; numericFields compare by value). duplicateKeysA / B: repeated keys; only the first row of a repeated key is compared. invalidNumeric: empty or non-decimal values in numericFields. A mismatch is a review hint, not proof of an error. This tool compares two files; it does not check real payments or orders.
